BiblicalUsage: Fine flour is the best of the wheat, ground smooth, and Sarah kneads it for the strangers at the door. The consecration offerings and the meal offerings are made of it, and the Nazirite brings cakes of it. The word is the offering of the best, given in the ordinary work of the kitchen.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe fine flour shows that God accepts the best of ordinary work, not only the grand gesture. Sarah's bread and the priest's offering are the same flour, and God takes both. I hold that the meal offering matters because it says a life of daily bread can be worship.
